component.name: DSView
component.summary: Logic analyzer and oscilloscope software for DreamSourceLab instruments

description.p: DSView is the capture and analysis software for DreamSourceLab USB logic analyzers (DSLogic) and oscilloscopes (DSCope). This is a fork of DreamSourceLab's DSView with extra oscilloscope tools, display options and protocol decoders.

ul.li: Logic analyzer captures with simple and advanced triggers
More than 100 protocol decoders, including I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB and I3C
Oscilloscope mode with FFT, math, histograms, reference waveforms and persistence
Export to CSV, VCD, gnuplot and sigrok session files
